parameters.note: Sierra Creek is a direct Lake Tahoe tributary (its mouth sits on the Lake Tahoe shoreline near Rubicon Bay). It is not individually named in §7.50, but the generic §7.50(b)(152)(A) provision governs all Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake — and Sierra Creek has no lake above it, so the whole creek is covered. Open catch-and-release only Sat. before Memorial Day through Sep. 30. Per §7.50(a)(1) the water is closed to ALL fishing (not just trout) the rest of the year — Oct. 1 through the Friday before the Saturday preceding Memorial Day. Date_spec encodes 'Saturday preceding Memorial Day' as the last Monday of May (Memorial Day) minus 2 days.

candidates.summary: Open catch-and-release only, Saturday before Memorial Day through Sept. 30; closed to all fishing the rest of the year (Lake Tahoe tributary special regulation).

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. The California/Nevada reciprocal-license arrangement is specific to fishing 'anywhere in Lake Tahoe' (the lake body); it does not extend to CA tributaries such as Sierra Creek, which require a California license.
